title: Action
description: Adds an engine action: contract, implementAction stub, registration, unit spec, HTTP spec and UI command stub. The generated tests fail until the action is implemented.

name.description: The action id, namespace.verb (for example queues.purge).

module.description: The service module that owns the action (svc-admin or admin). It must exist: create it with the service-module generator.

kind.description: query reads; command, peek and job change state or touch messages (peeks count as mutations).

http.description: The HTTP binding, 'METHOD /path' with {param} segments (for example 'POST /connections/{cid}/queues/{qkey}/purge'). GET only for a query. Omit for an action without a route.

permission.description: The permission from the RBAC catalogue (blueprint 7.3), area.verb.

risk.description: Required for anything but a query.

planning.description: Required for anything but a query. The environment policy may raise it, never lower it.

mcp.description: MCP exposure. read is only for a query; a command, peek or job is mutating or not exposed. Default none.

cli.description: The CLI command words, for example 'queues purge'.

summary.description: One line for the API document and the UI. Defaults to the id in words. Never call a read of messages non-destructive or read-only.

since.description: The contract version (major.minor) that introduces the action. Default 1.0.

feature.description: The UI feature that gets the command stub (libs/ui/feature-<name>), or none. Defaults to the module's name without svc-.
